title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price | TechCrunch
summary: Amazon recently unveiled its refreshed Kindle lineup , introducing a new basic Kindle , Paperwhite, and Colorsoft. The new Kindle Colorsoft starts at $290, while the Signature Edition, which I’ve spent the past few weeks testing, costs $320.
